transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I’ve just been feeling really down and empty inside for a very long time now. It has been going on constantly for about two years and two months, and I just can't shake this deep sadness.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I can't really point to any specific event or major change that started all of this. It just seemed to creep up on me and develop without any clear trigger. I've just felt this way for as long as I can remember lately.
During these past two years, have there been any stretches of two months or longer when you felt mostly back to normal, or has the low mood been there nearly every day the whole time?

No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. This gloomy feeling has been there nearly every single day for the entire two years and two months. I haven't had even a month, let alone two, where I felt back to my normal self.

During this time, have there been periods lasting at least two weeks when your depression became much worse and you also had several other symptoms like changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, poor concentration, guilt, or thoughts of death?

I haven't really noticed any distinct two-week periods where my depression got much worse with things like guilt or thoughts of death. It has just felt like a constant, lingering low mood that has stayed at the same level for the past two years and two months.

Along with the low mood, have you also had at least two of these most days for the past two years: low energy, poor appetite or overeating, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, low self-esteem, poor concentration, or feeling hopeless?

Yes, I've had awful sleep issues, like struggling to fall asleep, waking up constantly, and still feeling exhausted even when I sleep too much, plus my concentration is really poor and foggy. However, I haven't really noticed any changes in my appetite, and I wouldn't say I've struggled with low self-esteem or hopelessness.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days or longer when you felt unusually energized or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more talkative, impulsive, or full of ideas than usual?

No, I have never experienced anything like that at all. In fact, I've felt the complete opposite—just persistently down, sad, and constantly tired. I've never had those moments of high energy or feeling euphoric.
